follow-up time: From randomization or admission until delivery or discharge from the hospital
study type: Secondary analysis of a clinical trial (HYPITAT)
exposure: Women with and without severe hypertension
outcome: Pattern of systolic and diastolic blood pressure over time
Clinical factors influencing blood pressure patterns
Impact of severe hypertension on clinical management (mode of delivery)
cohort: 1076 women with a singleton pregnancy with a fetus in cephalic position between 36 and 41 weeks of gestation with the diagnosis of GH or mild PE.
finding: Blood pressure in patients with gestational hypertension or mild preeclampsia at term showed a non-linear increase over time, which was influenced by several clinical characteristics.
mod_finding: Development of severe hypertension was a risk factor for Caesarean section.
